Premise: holds

Pre-claim lane: spec + ui halves; `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` (domain:spec) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/owd-sharing.ts` (domain:ui); both stay with this seat under area-lease 留道.
Pre-claim deps: the card names no `Blocked-by:` and no "after #N"; hot files per overlap-check above.
Prior rulings read: controlled_by_parent,adr-0055 §1,refusal → 35 hits; ADR-0055 Decision §1–§4 decide the one-master RULE, none decides the refusal's wording; sibling #36512 (closed) already removed ADR numbers from the settings tab copy, same direction; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.

Premise reading: `grep -n "ADR-0055 §1" packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` at 87c7bbaf → message lines 231, 248, 288 still carry "ADR-0055 §1: since …"; `owd-sharing.ts` `cbpMasterRefusal` returns the issue `message` and `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` renders it in `owd-cbp-refusal` verbatim.

Scope (seat ruling): the whole card, not the narrow "drop the ADR citation" arm. The refusal carries a machine-readable code; the Studio panel renders business wording from that code through i18n (zh included); the published English refusal text also loses the ADR number. Clause-② is `yes` on the new ui language-pack keys (and on any new `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` code, if the route adds one); the dev measures the published closure and reports it.
